about.body: The N74 is BMW's flagship V12 petrol engine, produced from 2016 to 2022 and fitted exclusively to the seventh-generation 7 Series (G11/G12) in the 760i and M760Li variants. It's a 6.0-litre twelve-cylinder engine with twin turbochargers, and it represents the most complex rebuild work we undertake at BMW Garage — the V12 layout, twin-turbo arrangement, and the fact it was only fitted to one generation of one model make it a genuinely different proposition from the inline-six and V8 engines we work on more frequently.

byModel.body: The N74 was fitted exclusively to the 7 Series during its G11/G12 generation (2016–2022), in both the standard 760i and the higher-output M760Li. There is no other BMW model that uses this engine — a narrow application range compared to the broader B-series engines, but a significant one given the 7 Series' place in BMW's range.

compatibility.body: The N74 was only fitted to one model and generation: the 7 Series G11/G12. That means compatibility matching is more straightforward than with engines like the B58 that span multiple platforms — but the stakes are higher, because V12 parts are less common and more expensive. We confirm your exact 7 Series variant, production year, and VIN before any rebuild work begins, to ensure the correct specification for your car.
